test_designs: Five published chemical-name-seeded distinct context designs; all observed wells at each of the three context concentrations.
endpoint: Curve MAE over observed held-out concentration means, 4 DIVs x 17 features, then equal-weight mean over designs and chemicals.

C.predictions: Mean of three published CNP checkpoints for each outer fold, seeds 0/1/2; no training or selection in this run.

paired_difference: K minus C, negative favors K

bootstrap.resampling_unit: chemical identity within the held-out test cohort
bootstrap.method: paired percentile bootstrap of the equally weighted chemical differences; sorted chemical keys

identity_sensitivity.reason: Phenobarbital fold 4 and phenobarbital sodium fold 0 share the pre-existing conservative parent-identity cluster spid:EX000348. The original 194-row table remains primary; a 193-row sensitivity omits the test form whose parent identity occurs in training.

retained_results: All four preselected folds and all 194 primary chemicals, including negative differences, with a complete exclusion table.
inputs: Per-chemical published score subset and fold1–4 prediction arrays in this directory; source provenance in ../sources.json.
